title: Huge underwater UFO base spans city blocks in new whistleblower claims
excerpt: An Air Force veteran has revealed shocking new details of an alleged underwater invasion the military has known about for years.
content:
An Air Force veteran turned government whistleblower has shared startling new claims about an alleged UFO base hidden at the bottom of the ocean. 

David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who now assists lawmakers with UFO transparency, testified under oath in 2023 that the US government possesses multi-decade secret programs recovering and reverse-engineering crashed non-human spacecraft.

He recently made more claims about the government's knowledge of extraterrestrials, telling Joe Rogan that officials are aware of at least one giant underwater facility used by extraterrestrials as a 'base of operations' for their craft. 

'I'm going to be careful because it gets into sensitive Navy underwater things,' Grusch said. 

'There's clearly some sort of base of operations in certain locations. It's large. Don't know when it got there... Like multiple city blocks type stuff.'

He added that 'stuff comes and goes' from the base. 

Grusch also claimed that his information came from files on top-secret programs, videos and confessions from government and military insiders.

However, the US military and the White House have maintained for decades that no physical evidence has been found that proves UFOs and alien life exist.

Former Air Force Major David Grusch, a UFO whistleblower, was interviewed by podcast host Joe Rogan on September 30 

Grusch did not reveal how the military discovered the base or its location, only saying that the tracking methods were sensitive to national security, but added that he was sure the US had been studying what was taking place at the facility.

He then told Rogan that US naval officials had described the secret facility as the inspiration for the 1989 film The Abyss, in which an oil rig crew encounters non-human beings living in a vast underwater structure.

'I will tell you, underwater people, I know that come from that community, they're always like, "You know, the Abyss, Dave, it's kind of a docudrama." And I'm like, "Holy f***,"' he said during the September 30 episode.

Grusch spent 14 years in the Air Force before working as an intelligence officer for the National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), which builds and launches surveillance satellites for the Pentagon. 

From 2019 to 2021, he represented NRO on the task force investigating UFOs, but eventually became a whistleblower after allegedly learning that elements of the US government had prevented Congressional oversight on matters related to extraterrestrials. 

He then brought his claims to Congress, testifying to what he claimed the US government knew about non-human intelligence.

Grusch's bombshell claims on Rogan's podcast echoed similar allegations made by Tennessee congressman Tim Burchett, a member of the House Oversight Committee overseeing UFO reports, who said last year that alien 'entities' were currently living in deep-water areas on Earth.

Burchett said in a widely shared interview that there have been frequent sightings of unidentified craft around five or six specific deep-sea areas. These sites were believed to be in the Atlantic Ocean near the Bahamas.

Grusch told Rogan that the US government is aware of at least one underwater UFO base where 'stuff comes and goes.' Above is a screenshot of a video, which UFO insiders claims captures a UFO hovering over the Pacific Ocean

Burchett said in an interview with journalist Matt Laslo: 'We have naval personnel telling me we have these sightings, these underwater craft they're chasing that go hundreds of miles an hour, and the best we got is something that does maybe a little under forty miles an hour.'

Grusch also told Rogan that he was shown video of dead bodies recovered from the crash site of an alleged alien spacecraft. This top-secret footage was said to be 'contemporary' and not grainy, unreliable recordings from the 1950s.

He alleged that the beings he saw were 'very beautiful' with pale, bluish-white skin, which were now being kept in a frozen storage facility for further examination.

Rogan asked: 'This video, do you think this will be a part of disclosure, that we'll get to see this video of these dead bodies?'

'Probably. There's a lot of audio-visual stuff. The problem with the current climate like you're going to have to wheel out the physical evidence, too, because the trust in government is so low right now,' Grusch claimed.
